title: Mobile App Rewrites via Dual Boot
abstract: arXiv:2608.15135v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We term the mechanism dual boot: the ability to host two mobile application variants within a single binary with a boot-time variant selection. This mechanism, combined with build-generated symbol resolution maps and linker retain lists, also enables two additional capabilities not inherent to the mechanism alone: (1) in-binary A/B experimentation between full application variants, and (2) graceful deprecation of the legacy variant without user disruption: preserving app store listing, branding, and install base. We frame the complete lifecycle as the first application of the Strangler Fig pattern to native mobile platforms. We validate the architecture across three evaluation scenarios, with improvements in developer productivity, experimentation capability and flexibility. The system contributed to a complete iOS application rewrite, from initial embedding through multi-segment experimentation to full deprecation of the legacy variant,

translated_title: 通过双启动实现移动应用重写
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.15135v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们称这种机制为“双启动”：即在单个二进制文件中承载两个移动应用变体，并在启动时选择变体的能力。这一机制结合构建生成的符号解析映射和链接器保留列表，还实现了该机制本身不具备的两项额外能力：（1）在完整应用变体之间进行二进制内的A/B实验，（2）在不干扰用户的情况下优雅地弃用旧变体：保留应用商店列表、品牌和安装基础。我们将这一完整生命周期定义为Strangler Fig模式在原生移动平台上的首次应用。我们在三个评估场景中验证了这一架构，显著提升了开发者生产力、实验能力和灵活性。该系统促成了完整的iOS应用重写，从初始嵌入到多段实验，再到旧变体的完全弃用。
tldr: 本文提出“双启动”机制，通过在单个二进制中托管两个应用变体并支持启动时选择，结合构建生成的符号映射和链接器保留列表，实现了原生移动应用的无缝重写、二进制内A/B实验及旧版本优雅弃用，首次将Strangler Fig模式应用于移动平台。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "dual boot" mechanism that hosts two app variants in a single binary with boot-time selection, enabling seamless native app rewrites, in-binary A/B experimentation, and graceful legacy deprecation, marking the first application of the Strangler Fig pattern to mobile platforms.
